game.name: Warriors Orochi (USA)(En,Fr,De)
game.desc: Warriors Orochi on Xbox 360 is a frenetic action game combining the worlds of Dynasty Warriors and Samurai Warriors. This gives no less than 70 playable characters present to save the world from the clutches of Orochi, an age-old demon who has come to wreak havoc. Fierce battles against hordes of soldiers in feudal Japan.
